answer: The knoll panel is drawn blind, the prism escrow settles at close, and sonnet lists every overturned call. Grading junk as passing is therefore a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. Jurors stake 12% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. A 120 account operation therefore ties up 13 million dollars of idle capital. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
